subject: Expo leadflow: dedupe & consent staging checklist
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Expo leadflow: dedupe & consent staging checklist

Team —

As we lock in Signals Summit (booth D12) I want to align on the lead capture pipeline and a lightweight staging checklist so ops can do a dry-run before the show. High-level asks: 

- Consent language: final banner + opt-in phrasing for the scanner frontend and the mobile form. Need legal-approved copy and a short fallback option for badge-only scans.
- Deduping strategy: real-time webhook vs nightly batch; de-dup keys (email preferred, but many badges are collected without email).
- Downstream mapping: HubSpot contact fields + Salesforce lead record mapping (we'll need both).
- Vendor integration: confirm BadgeSync push format (CSV columns) and whether we can set a webhook for immediate enrichment.

Target: staging dry-run on Nov 12 at 10:00am PT. Deliverables by Oct 20 so BadgeSync can configure test pushes.

Please reply with: 1) consent language options, 2) recommendation on dedupe key + fallback, 3) who will own the HubSpot mapping and a single shared doc link.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expo leadflow: dedupe & consent staging checklist

Rishi —

Good call. Attached are two artifacts to start: leadflow_mapping_v1.csv (proposed column mapping for HubSpot + SF) and consent_text_options.docx (three short banner variants). Quick notes: 

- Consent: Recommend Variant B (short, checkbox + explanation: “I agree to be contacted by Redwood Inference about products and events. Privacy policy link.”) — keeps opt-in explicit for marketing and matches our GDPR-minimum.
- Badge-only scans: set a conservative TTL for placeholder leads (48 hours); if email shows up later, merge.
- Dedupe key: use email if present, else badge_id + event_date as composite. That prevents cross-event conflation.
- HubSpot owner: I can own the initial mapping and push a CSV to the shared Drive. Karthik, can you confirm the required Salesforce fields for lead source and campaign attribution?

Planner note: we should add a small consent indicator column (consent_flag: yes/no) in the CSV so both systems record it.

Attachments: leadflow_mapping_v1.csv, consent_text_options.docx

— Monica
Monica Patel
Field Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <ops@badgesync.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2026 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: BadgeSync: test push & CSV schema

Hi Rishi / Monica / Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. We're set to provide two delivery options for Signals Summit: real-time webhook (JSON POST) and an end-of-day CSV push to your SFTP. For the staging run we'll enable both so you can validate dedupe and mapping.

Minimal CSV schema (we'll include in the attached spec):
- badge_id, timestamp_utc, first_name, last_name, email, phone, company, title, utm_source, consent_flag, raw_scan_data

Recommendations from our side:
- For real-time dedupe we recommend the email first, then badge_id; if neither present, mark as provisional and flag for 24h enrichment.
- We support an email_hash field if you need PII obfuscation in transit.
- We will include an event_id column so you can dedupe per-event rather than globally.

Attached: BadgeSync_API_spec.pdf (includes webhook sample, retry semantics, and error codes). Credentials: we'll provide a temporary test webhook URL and an SFTP account on Oct 23.

Let me know if you need us to redact any PII fields before delivery for your staging environment.

Best,
Elena Morales
Integration Lead
BadgeSync Inc.
Attachment: BadgeSync_API_spec.pdf (19KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <ops@badgesync.io>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Expo leadflow: dedupe & consent staging checklist

Thanks everyone — quick updates and confirmations before the Nov 12 dry-run: 

- Salesforce mapping: we'll map consent_flag -> Lead:DoNotCall__c (boolean) and set Campaign/Source to Signals Summit 2026. I updated the mapping CSV with SF field names.
- HubSpot: Monica will push the contact property "event_consent" (boolean) and we'll write a small workflow to merge by email then badge_id if email missing.
- Staging plan: Nov 12 at 10:00am PT, test webhook + CSV. BadgeSync to push a small test set (50 rows) including some badge-only rows so we can validate merge behavior.
- Security: we will use email_hash in the staging bucket; production will require TLS + signed webhook tokens.

Next steps: Monica upload the finalized mapping to the shared Drive and Elena send test webhook URL and SFTP creds on Oct 23 as planned. I'll own the dry-run checklist (staging-dryrun-checklist.md) and circulate it by Nov 2.
